title: 1995 South Africa Truth and Reconciliation Commission design — truth, conditional amnesty and reparation

decision_cutoff.date_or_period: 1995 before implementation of the Promotion of National Unity and Reconciliation Act
decision_cutoff.definition: South Africa's democratic transition decision whether to create a truth commission offering individual conditional amnesty for politically motivated acts on full disclosure, while documenting gross human-rights violations and creating reparation/rehabilitation mechanisms.
decision_cutoff.research_note: Original adoption/design question retained. Exact pre-adoption legislative review event and receipt of the complete terms have not been verified. The original Act was assented to on 19 July 1995 and published on 26 July; publication is a version anchor, not a replacement decision cutoff. Do not shift this question to a later implementation review to admit the statute.

sources.citation: South Africa, Promotion of National Unity and Reconciliation Act 34 of 1995, original Government Gazette 16579, 26 July 1995
sources.use_note: Original English Gazette text only, SHA-256 7e02f146e23eed4d3befca3bab1e301cd88a503623338897b6bc0c566aa1c2fd. Reconstructs enacted design; does not establish pre-adoption receipt or operational delivery. Later amendments, AZAPO and implementation stay reveal-only.

sources.citation: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of South Africa, Final Report
sources.use_note: Reveal source on implementation, findings, amnesty, victim testimony and reparation recommendations.

sources.citation: AZAPO and Others v President of the Republic of South Africa and Others, Constitutional Court, 1996
sources.use_note: Reveal/legal-review source upholding the amnesty framework while discussing transition, truth and reparations.

sources.citation: South African Government / Department of Justice materials on Truth and Reconciliation Commission
sources.use_note: Official archive of TRC structure, proceedings and records.

sources.citation: UN Ad Hoc Working Group of Experts, E/CN.4/1995/23, 13 January 1995, paras. 20,38–40,48–51
sources.use_note: Primary report in university mirror; transition statements, testimony and resource constraints, with allegations distinguished from findings. Official UN endpoint inaccessible; individual decision-maker receipt unresolved.

sources.citation: Goldstone Commission Final Report, 27 October 1994, ss3.3–3.4.1,4.1–4.2
sources.use_note: Primary report reproduced in research repository. Existing prosecutions/civil claims and witness-protection needs; no later trial outcomes or general prosecution-capacity conclusion.

correction_11_admission.reason: Exact pre-adoption cutoff/receipt and several harm, preference and operational capacity premises remain unresolved; statutory version pinning is not temporal admission.
